fields.description:
h3. What

A Board View card shows the same status pill as List and Tech View, with the red service-actions and blue parts-actions counts.

h3. Expected

S3-R5a: "A Board View card's status is the same status pill List shows in production, with the same red service-actions count and blue parts-actions count on it, as in Tech View (S2-R19), at the design's card badge height (22px)." The badge stays in a fixed spot on the card (S3-R5).

PRD: [Board View & Tech View PRD v55|https://shopview.atlassian.net/wiki/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=845185030] (S3-R5a, S6-R2a).

h3. Actual (origin/develop, 2026-10-15)

The card shows a plain badge with the status name only: no red or blue counts, and not the List's pill.

h3. How to check

* A card for a work order with pending service actions shows the red count; with pending parts actions, the blue count; with tooltips as in List.
* The pill is 22px tall and in the same place on every card.
* The pill reads the same as that work order's pill in List and Tech View.

From the PRD v54/v55 rulings on Bilal's and Slavcho's questions, 2026-10-15.
